title.narrative: Gender equality decisionmaking-UNDP-MNG-00114124

description.narrative: Strengthening legal environment for women representation, raising public awareness on gender equality and strengthening support mechanism for women in decision-making level
capital of a political entity

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

title.narrative: Annual Output Results
Number of women interested in public decision making

description.narrative: This indicator is being measured by Pre-and-post training survey question - "Are you planning to run for election in 2024?" among the women who participated in women's leadership training.

title.narrative: Number of GE status reports submitted to Cabinet and Parliament.

description.narrative: This indicator measures the frequency of annual gender equality status reports submitted to the cabinet and parliament.

title.narrative: Number of Regional Leadership Forums

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of annual forums held to establish regional forums for gender-equitable political empowerment and to build mentoring/networking opportunities for women politicians.

title.narrative: Number of Advocacy Initiatives

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of gender equality advocacy initiatives conducted for political parties, candidates, and the parliament.

title.narrative: Number of gender trainings in PPs

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of gender equality education programs conducted for party officials and members

title.narrative: Number of voters trained

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of individuals who completed gender-focused awareness raising training/programs targeted at voters and youth (informal voters)

title.narrative: Number of Leadership Training Programs

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of leadership training programs conducted for female party members, young women, and women working in urban and rural private sectors.

title.narrative: Number of media coverages by journalists attended the GE training

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of media materials, including news and articles, reported with a gender perspective, after conducting gender-sensitive reporting training for media practitioners (including SNS opinion leaders).

title.narrative: Number of women who participated in the leadership training programs

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of participants in public decision-making training programs/women's political leadership and campaign management training conducted for women leaders of Women's Leadership Network, and relevant government officials and members of the parliament, such as those organized by the CSO consortium and NCGE.

title.narrative: Number of total participants of gender training (by sex)

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of participants who attended gender-sensitive reporting training for media practitioners (including SNS opinion leaders).

title.narrative: Number of participants for the male championship

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of party officials and members, public officials, and leaders from various sectors (public, private and media sector) who participated in male advocacy programs.

title.narrative: Number of political parties which conducted gender self-assessments

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of political parties that have conducted internal gender evaluations. * Key contents of self-assessment (example): Compliance with women's quota system and accessibility of party funds for female members.

title.narrative: Number of women who have been approached by the initiatives as (the number of women who have become) potential aspirants

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women who accessed initiatives implemented through the project

title.narrative: Number of Women Participating in Leadership Training Programs

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women who participated in leadership training programs conducted for female party members, young women, and women working in urban and rural private sectors

title.narrative: Percentage increase in willingness to take positive action to gender parity by participants who have completed awareness raising programs

description.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage increase in positive gender-related behavior intentions among participants who completed gender-sensitive reporting education (pre-and post-training comparison).

title.narrative: Percent of participants who have shared or intend to share the content of awareness raising activities with others in their community

description.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage of male championship participants who have shared or intend to share the content of awareness raising activities with others in their community

title.narrative: Number of women agreed to apply to be a candidate

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women candidates ran for national and sub-national elections (2020, 2024 general elections)

title.narrative: Proportion of seats held by women in national parliaments and local governments

description.narrative: Proportion of seats held by women in national parliaments and local governments

title.narrative: Number of legal mechanisms which supports WPP

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of new legal mechanisms introduced to expand and support women's participation in public decision-making. *Definition of Legal Mechanisms: Proposed bills (election laws, political funding laws, political party laws etc. ), officially adopted political party policies, rules, and regulations.

title.narrative: % of voters agree on increased quotas

description.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage of voters who agree to increase the women's quota before and after conducting voter education and campaigns targeting voters.

title.narrative: % of increased willingness to vote for women candidates

description.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage increase in voting intentions for female candidates before and after conducting voter education and campaigns targeting voters.
